firm_data.firm_description: Ezdrin, Woods, & Gluzberg is a law firm located in Syosset, NY, providing legal services in family, matrimonial, criminal law and real estate. They serve clients in Nassau County, Suffolk County, the Five New York Boroughs, and the surrounding areas.

email.subject: AI for Ezdrin, Woods, & Gluzberg - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Charo,

Family and matrimonial law require precision and client trust, especially across the Nassau County and Five Boroughs territories you serve. Most firms your size are still managing these cases with outdated workflows.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Syosset office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
